title: Devices
description: Connect phones, tablets and the desktop app with a QR code: each device has its own access that you can revoke at any time.

empty.title: No paired devices
empty.description: Pair your phone or the desktop app with the “Pair a device” button.
empty.descriptionOwner: Pair the staff phones or the cash desk desktop app with the “Pair a device” button.

lan.title: Turn on the local network mode
lan.description: In local mode the desktop app cannot be reached by other devices. Turn on the local network mode from the app menu (system tray icon), then come back here to pair phones and other PCs.

pair.title: Pair a device
pair.description: Scan the QR code with the Arenile app (phone, or desktop app in remote mode). The code works once and expires after 5 minutes.
pair.userHint: The device gets the permissions of this user's role, in this establishment only.
pair.qrUnavailable: QR code not available: type the code by hand.
pair.expiredDescription: For security the code is valid for 5 minutes. Generate a new one.
pair.step1: Open the Arenile app on the device.
pair.step2: Choose “Connect to an instance” and scan the QR code.
pair.step3: Or type the address and the code shown above.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.message: The device loses access immediately. To use it again it must be paired with a new code.
revoke.messageBridge: The device loses access immediately and stops acting as fiscal bridge: fiscal documents stay pending until you register another bridge.

push.title: Push notifications on the mobile app
push.description: Alerts on staff phones even when the app is closed. They go through the Coste360 relay, which only receives a pseudonymous phone identifier and a generic text (for example “New online booking”): never names, codes or amounts.

enabled.label: Send push notifications
enabled.help: Off by default. Each person then turns them on in the app on their own phone and only receives the alerts their role allows.

booking_new_online.label: New online booking
booking_new_online.help: A booking from the public page is confirmed. All roles.

booking_approval_requested.label: Booking awaiting approval
booking_approval_requested.help: A request is waiting for your approval. Owner, manager and cashier.

payment_failed.label: Payment failed
payment_failed.help: An online payment did not go through. Owner and manager.

noRelay.title: Push notifications are not configured on this server
noRelay.description: The Coste360 relay key is required (ARENILE_PUSH_RELAY_KEY variable). Without it the app refreshes the data when you open it. Push notifications are not available in the desktop app.
